name: Korean · textbook print
description: Forty modern standalone Hangul jamo drawn as original, clean monoline print forms. Motor segmentation follows the EPS Korean standard textbook diagrams; technical preview, not pedagogically certified. No syllable-block composition or recording-derived geometry.

references.title: EPS Korean standard textbook: Hangeul introduction
references.note: Visually inspected PDF pages 2-6 (printed pages 13-17): basic vowels, compound vowels, basic and aspirated consonants, double consonants. Consulted numbered arrows for motor order and direction only; source artwork is not embedded or traced. Geometry is original. The MIT license covers this authored geometry, not the reference PDF.
